noncomputable def Data.linePair {P : Parameters} {D : Data P} (j : D.LiftIndex) : Option ℤˣ →
  D.Pair := by
  let n := j + (D.t - 11 * D.m - 1) / 2
  refine' Option.rec (.mk _ (D.w j · - n) _ D.heckeCount (((D.mu₀_hasWeight j).mul_upsilonU1_pow
    n).of_weight_eq _) ..) fun s ↦ ⟨_ * _ ^ (s.1 * j), fun _ ↦ D.eSign s, _, D.eSign s, by
    simpa using! (WeilData.hasWeight_upsilonU1_pow _).inv.mul (D.chi_hasWeight.zpow _), _, _, _, _⟩
  any_goals refine' fun v ↦ .trans (b := (D.w j v : ℝ)) (Nat.mono_cast _) _
  all_goals grind [heckeCount, eSign, omega_eq_one_of_not_isChosen, _root_.one_zpow, Pi.pow_apply,
    w_le_two_mul_b]

linePolyCoords.statement:
abbrev linePolyCoords i (Y : _ := D.shortRows i) :=
  firstColsCoord (untwistedAuxPair j).colsPlus (stackedDetProd (posEquiv j) (detRows j i Y))

lPlusDatum.name: Data.lPlusDatum

lineMultiplier.name: Data.lineMultiplier
lineMultiplier.statement:
def lineMultiplier (i : MemberIndex j) h l :=
  modKernelI (stdSpace ..).neg (upsilonU1 ^ j.1) (bigChar ϑ j) (D.𝔪 ϑ 2)
  (Pi.single (inclMatrix _ (inl ∘ inr ∘ inl)) 1) 1 1 h * stdClassSum (Kf ..) fun c ↦ carrierXi D.m
  (twistedChi ϑ j) c * modKernelI (stdSpace ..) (bigChar ϑ j) (bigChar ϑ j) _ (lPlusDatum ϑ j i.1)
  ((linePolyCoords j i.2) l) (1, U.blockSumOne (1, U.blockSumOne (i.2.1.out, c))) h

carddetIndex.name: Data.card_detIndex
carddetIndex.statement:
lemma card_detIndex τ : card (DetIndex j τ) = (range (card (BigIndex j))).sum
  ((untwistedAuxPair j).colsPlus τ) ∧ card (DetIndex j τ) ≤ D.b₁ + D.b₂ + D.h + D.m * D.h

weylNormSqlinePolyCoords.name: Data.weylNormSq_linePolyCoords_le
weylNormSqlinePolyCoords.statement:
lemma weylNormSq_linePolyCoords_le z : let y := φ ∘ eval z ∘ linePolyCoords j i Y; toPoly _ _ y =
    .map (φ.comp (eval z)) (inFirstCols (stackedDetProd (posEquiv j) (detRows j i Y))) ∧
    (((∀ τ a b, ‖φ (Φ τ (Y a b))‖ ≤ D.gProd ^ 4) ∧ ∀ x, ‖φ (z x)‖ ≤ D.gProd ^ 4) → weylNormSq y ≤
    ↑(D.gProd ^ 9) ^ (31 * D.m * ∑ τ, card (DetIndex j τ)))

toPolylinePolyCoords.name: Data.toPoly_linePolyCoords
toPolylinePolyCoords.statement:
lemma toPoly_linePolyCoords : toPoly _ _ (linePolyCoords j i Y) =
  inFirstCols (stackedDetProd (posEquiv j) (detRows j i Y))

existsdenomlinePolyCoords.name: Data.exists_denom_linePolyCoords
existsdenomlinePolyCoords.statement:
lemma exists_denom_linePolyCoords : ∃ d ≤ 31 * D.m * ∑ τ, card (DetIndex j τ), ∃ H : ℤ, 0 < H ∧ H ≤
  (d ^ d) ^ 3 ∧ ∀ i Y l,
  let Q := H • linePolyCoords j i Y l; (∀ c ≠ (0 : ℂ), aeval (c • .X ·) Q = c ^ d • Q) ∧
  ∀ A : Subring ℂ, (∀ τ a b, Φ τ (Y a b) ∈ A) → Q ∈ (MvPolynomial.map A.subtype).range

normmulgProd.name: Data.norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus
normmulgProd.statement:
lemma Data.norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus {ϑ c} : ↑(ϑ.levelNorm * D.gProd ^ c) ∈ (D.𝔪 ϑ
  c).ideal

lineMultiplierintegral.name: Data.lineMultiplier_integral_and_small
lineMultiplierintegral.statement:
lemma Data.lineMultiplier_integral_and_small : ∃ c ≠ (0 : ℂ), ∀ i ϑ h, let y := star (c •
    lineMultiplier ϑ j i h); (∀ p [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p], p.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm →
    weylGauge _ 0 h y ≤ 1) ∧ (ϑ.Q = ∅ → ∀ φ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ, weylNormSq (φ ∘ y) ≤ .exp (D.r * D.B₀))
